court_name: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH AT AMARAVATI
raw_summary: The High Court of Andhra Pradesh dismissed the criminal appeal filed by the appellant, confirming his conviction and sentence for offences under Section 363 IPC, Section 302 IPC, and Section 6 of the POCSO Act. The conviction was based on circumstantial evidence, including the appellant being the last person seen with the deceased minor before her death, and evidence suggesting rape and murder.
